The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had a '''base'''<ref name="Order of Outcasts">{{CWACite|5|The Order of Outcasts}}</ref>  during the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]]<ref name="Date">"[[The Order of Outcasts]]" takes place during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> of the  [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy.<ref name="Order of Outcasts" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Battle of Ragmar V|attacked]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] in order to use it as a staging world to ultimately attack the Separatist base.<ref name="Order of Outcasts" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base was mentioned in the short story "[[The Order of Outcasts]]," which was one of four stories compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]<ref name="Order of Outcasts" /> published on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-402/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-5-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 5 TPB}}</ref>
